# Acme error reference

Every error acme returns is a `google.rpc.Status` with a
`google.rpc.ErrorInfo` naming its reason (AIP-193). Branch on the reason,
never on the message.

## Standard reasons

<!-- protoc-gen-service:errors:begin servicex -->
<!-- Generated by protoc-gen-service. DO NOT EDIT between these markers: regenerate, then copy this fragment over the one in your error reference. -->

| Reason | Code | Means | Do | Retry? |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `NOT_FOUND` | `NOT_FOUND` | The resource named does not exist, or is deleted. | Check the name; list what exists. | No |
| `ALREADY_EXISTS` | `ALREADY_EXISTS` | A create's id is taken, or an Undelete names something not deleted. | Choose another id, or leave it empty; read the existing one. | No |
| `CONCURRENT_MODIFICATION` | `ABORTED` | The etag sent is no longer current, or another writer won the race for the same record. | Read the resource again, reapply the change, retry with the new etag. | Yes |
| `REQUIRED_FIELD` | `INVALID_ARGUMENT` | A field the call needs is empty. | Set it. | No |
| `INVALID_ID` | `INVALID_ARGUMENT` | A `*_id` is not a valid id: lower-case letters, digits and hyphens, starting with a letter, at most 63 characters (AIP-122). | Fix it, or leave it empty to have one assigned. | No |
| `MALFORMED_NAME` | `INVALID_ARGUMENT` | A resource name is not shaped like the collection it should be in. | Send the full name the create call returned. | No |
| `NOTHING_TO_UPDATE` | `INVALID_ARGUMENT` | An update sets no field and names none in `update_mask`. | Set the fields to change and name them in `update_mask`. | No |
| `UNKNOWN_MASK_PATH` | `INVALID_ARGUMENT` | `update_mask` names a field the resource does not have. | Name fields by their proto names. | No |
| `IMMUTABLE_FIELD` | `INVALID_ARGUMENT` | An update changes a field that cannot change once set (AIP-203 IMMUTABLE). | Leave it out of `update_mask`, or create a new resource. | No |
| `INVALID_ARGUMENT` | `INVALID_ARGUMENT` | The request is wrong in a way no more specific reason names (a bad filter, a bad page token). | Read the message. | No |
| `INVALID_STATE` | `FAILED_PRECONDITION` | The resource's state forbids the call, in a way no more specific reason names. | Read the message. | No |
<!-- protoc-gen-service:errors:end servicex -->


## acme.booking.v1

<!-- protoc-gen-service:errors:begin acme.booking.v1 -->
<!-- Generated by protoc-gen-service. DO NOT EDIT between these markers: regenerate, then copy this fragment over the one in your error reference. -->

Domain `booking.acme.example`.

| Reason | Code | Means | Do | Retry? |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `HOLD_NOT_ACTIVE` | `FAILED_PRECONDITION` | The hold expired, was released, or became a reservation. | Take a new hold. | No |
| `CAPACITY_EXHAUSTED` | `FAILED_PRECONDITION` | Fewer resources are free for the window than were asked for. | Ask for fewer, or another window. | No |
| `HOLD_NOT_FOUND` | `INVALID_ARGUMENT` | The reservation's hold does not exist. | Take a hold first with CreateHold. | No |
| `ENGINE_BUSY` | `RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED` | As many evaluations as the server runs at once were running. | Retry after a short randomized backoff. | Yes |
<!-- protoc-gen-service:errors:end acme.booking.v1 -->
